title: Great trash can! Fits a lot of trash! Good pricing too!
text: Great trash can! Fits a lot of trash! Good pricing too!. Works great! I love this wastebasket. It's very convenient and has a small lid space to pull up to place the waste bags inside as well, or take them out. My normal trash bags fit right in and it works great! The only inconvenience I've seen so far is that it slides back each time I use it (the more I step on it the further back it goes). It gets on the wall and has so far left a dark mark on my white wall. But other than that it works great. If you have something to put between the trash and your wall or can place it inside a room that you don't care about the walls then it's perfect!
